chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥammād, from al-Mufaḍḍal, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “How were you when you were in the shadows?”

So he عليه السلام said: “O Mufaḍḍal, we were with our Lord. There was no one with Him other than us, in a green canopy. We glorified Him, declared His holiness, proclaimed His oneness, and magnified Him. And there was neither any near angel nor any possessor of spirit other than us, until it became manifest to Him to create things. So He created whatever He willed, however He willed, from the angels and others besides them; then He conveyed the knowledge of that to us.”

key_terms.الْأَظِلَّةِ: the shadows; a pre-creational state mentioned in the narration
key_terms.ظُلَّةٍ خَضْرَاءَ: a green canopy or shade in which they were present
key_terms.عِلْمَ ذَلِكَ: the knowledge of that; knowledge pertaining to the creation mentioned
key_terms.مَلَكٍ مُقَرَّبٍ: a near angel brought close to Allah
key_terms.نُسَبِّحُهُ: we glorified Him; declaring Allah's transcendence
key_terms.نُقَدِّسُهُ: we declared His holiness and sanctity
key_terms.نُهَلِّلُهُ: we proclaimed His oneness by saying tahlil

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the pre-creational station of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a pre-creational state in which the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام were with their Lord, engaged in tasbih, taqdis, tahlil, and tamjid before the creation of angels and other beings. It presents their unique proximity and their reception of knowledge concerning creation, reflecting a cosmological and theological teaching in Shia tradition.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ali Bin Hammad, from Al Mufazzal who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘How were you<sup>asws</sup> all when you<sup>asws</sup> were in the shadows?’

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Mufazzal! We<sup>asws</sup> were with of our<sup>asws</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> There wasn’t anyone with Him<sup>azwj</sup> apart from us<sup>asws</sup> in the green shadow. We<sup>asws</sup> praised Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and we<sup>asws</sup> extolled His<sup>azwj</sup> Holiness, and we<sup>asws</sup> extolled His<sup>azwj</sup> Oneness, and we<sup>asws</sup> Praised Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and there was none from an Angel of Proximity nor anyone with a spirit apart from us<sup>asws</sup> until there was a beginning for it in the creation of the things. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> so Desired from the Angels and others, then the knowledge of that ended up to us<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 7. from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim from Ali ibn Hammad from al-Mufaddal who has said the following.
“I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), “How did you exist when you existed in the shadows?”

The Imam (a.s.) said, “O Mufaddal, we were in the presence of our Lord and there was no one else in the green shadow. We would speak of His Glory, Holiness, acknowledge Him as the Lords and speak of His Majesty. There was no angel even of the ones close to Allah or a living being except us in His presence until He decided to create all things. He then created whatever He wanted, in the He wanted of the angels and others. The knowledge of that then came to us.”
